decision: Complete the registered three-method three-seed comparison and original one-use gate; no runtime reward/scene/network changes or extra budgets. Conditional formal expansion requires original gate; failed gate stops this advantage branch and retains negative results.
rationale: Current negative development evidence does not establish the whole three-seed gate outcome. Continuing is justified to test the registered hypothesis, not to assume positive contribution. Strong classical reference and joint effect/nondegradation rules remain unchanged.
limitations: Fixed100 worlds per stage/seed, not IID per-episode resampling
Single delayed physical packet and hidden Nom memory: partial observability
Aggregate RMS calibration leaves local covariance/rank/reachable-set differences
Reward-scale diagnostic is not a causal failure test
Small unequal height subgroups cannot identify height causality
Frozen final nine terrains use regular geometry; extra parameter pressures do not establish all extreme-terrain robustness
Only first seed currently available; novelty and practical safety remain unproven
